    How AIR Calculated 34%

    AIR combines execution stability, business flow health, release risk, and current coverage signals. Future AIR Core engines will make this formula fully configurable.

    Critical Flow Health 1% Business journey health based on configured critical flow modules.
    Business Health 1% Overall business module stability in this execution.
    Risk High Release risk from failures, warnings, and configured thresholds.
    Execution Stability Review Failures require investigation before approval.
